verdict.rationale: Bento's MCP server and CLI let an AI assistant programmatically look up subscribers/audiences, track events, and build/manage automation flows (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-9, bento-docs-16, bento-docs-18), and Bento ties revenue back to specific emails/flows (bento-docs-6), which supports 'reporting on what's working.' However, the docs describe MCP as covering subscribers, broadcasts, and events with only 'and more' — there's no explicit documented endpoint/command for pulling structured campaign performance metrics, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent actually generating a performance report end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit analytics/reporting API or MCP tool documentation, independent verification that campaign-results reporting works via the agent surfaces.
